title.en: Chapter 3 — The Bet at the Club

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The bank director said: it was big?

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: قصدي إنه اليوم بتقدر تلف حولها بتمانين يوم.
sentences.en: Fogg said: I mean that today you can go round it in eighty days.

sentences.ar: بعد ما فتحوا سكة الحديد بالهند.
sentences.en: Since the railway was opened in India.
San Francisco to New York, seven.
The bank director said: on paper!

sentences.ar: بس في عواصف، وريح، وقطارات بتتأخر، وسفن بتغرق.
sentences.en: But there are storms, winds, late trains, ships that sink.
The bank director said: in theory!
The bank director said: I would like to see it!
And there was silence at the table.

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: عندي عشرين ألف جنيه بالبنك.
sentences.en: Fogg said: I have twenty thousand pounds in the bank.

sentences.ar: بلف حول الدنيا بتمانين يوم، أو أقل.
sentences.en: I go round the world in eighty days, or less.

sentences.ar: قال المهندس: يا فوغ، هاد جنون.
sentences.en: The engineer said: Fogg, this is madness.

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: الإنجليزي ما بيمزح بالرهان.
sentences.en: Fogg said: an Englishman does not joke about a wager.

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: قطار دوفر بيطلع الساعة 8:45 الليلة.
sentences.en: Fogg said: the Dover train leaves at 8:45 tonight.

sentences.ar: برجع لهون، لهالصالة، يوم السبت، 21 ديسمبر.
sentences.en: I come back here, to this room, on Saturday, 21 December.

sentences.ar: وإذا ما رجعت، العشرين ألف إلكم.
sentences.en: And if I do not come back, the twenty thousand are yours.
And they wrote the wager on a paper, and signed.
And Fogg finished the game, and won.
And rose at 7:25 exactly, and went home.
